text.tspan: Define delivered success, wrong-action cost, deadline and budget; assess the simple path
Does the current result meet the requirement?
Return the validated result and stop
Reliable tool or user feedback available?
Acquire the information and retain the result
Ask for the missing input, defer or abstain
Can outcomes be checked at acceptable cost?
Correct candidates already occur often enough?
Sample diverse candidates and check within total budget
Use stronger model, better context or trained repair
Can branches be replayed or safely isolated?
Use bounded revision or prefix search
Evaluate plans before one committed action
Use limited sampling with calibrated selection
Improve verification or use human judgment
Count generation, checking, controls, tools and retries
Update remaining budget, elapsed time and resource use
Fits remaining budget, deadline and parallel resource limit?
Reduce depth or width, route stronger, or simplify
Expected marginal value exceeds total marginal cost and error risk?
Return current validated result, defer or abstain
Execute the next bounded increment and update the current result
